about: The registered corpus. Each source is fetched into sources/_cache/<id>/ by tools/fetch_sources.sh at the pinned version. Licence evidence is quoted from where it was read.

sources.title: Algorithms for Competitive Programming (cp-algorithms)
sources.format: Markdown under src/, navigation in src/navigation.md, C++ code
sources.locator: cpa:<path under src/ without .md>#<heading slug>, e.g. cpa:graph/dijkstra#implementation

sources.title: Coding Interview University
sources.use: syllabus and link lists; little prose of its own

sources.title: Algorithms (1st edition, June 2019)

sources.use: prose and exercises (mostly unkeyed; the author asks not to be asked for solutions)
sources.format: PDF per chapter; text via pdftotext -layout (small-caps algorithm names come out garbled; verbatim conversion needs a better pass)
sources.locator: jeffe:<chapter number>.<section number>, e.g. jeffe:3.4; exercises jeffe:<chapter>.ex<number>
